biotools.summary: Pipette is a multi-agent AI framework that orchestrates end-to-end bioinformatics workflows through natural language interaction. It utilizes a literature-derived Skill Graph to constrain workflow generation to biologically valid analytical transitions, making complex analysis accessible to non-experts.
